promise: Invest $51 billion in the Argentina LNG project under the RIGI large-investment incentive regime to export gas from Vaca Muerta
description: On August 14, 2026, YPF announced it would file its Argentina LNG project under the Large Investment Incentive Regime (RIGI), the largest RIGI application to date at $51 billion, in a project developed with ENI and XRG to export liquefied natural gas from the Vaca Muerta formation. The project aims to position Argentina as a major LNG exporter; no completion date was disclosed, so end of 2032 is used as a review horizon.
evidence: YPF announced the RIGI filing on August 14, 2026
